items.title: SWECO: Sweco awarded SEK 182 million framework agreement by Danish utility company
items.summary: SWECO: Sweco awarded SEK 182 million framework agreement by Danish utility company 2026-10-27 08:00:00 Sweco has been awarded a framework agreement as sole consultant to Aalborg Forsyning, a municipally owned multi-utility company in Denmark. The two-year agreement has a maximum value of SEK 182 million for Sweco and runs until September 2028, with an option to extend by up to two years. Aalborg Forsyning provides a range of services, including district heating, electricity, heat generation, drinking water, wastewater and district cooling, to households and businesses in and around Aalborg in northern Denmark. items.title: SWECO: Sweco awarded framework agreements worth SEK 500 million for high-security facilities in Sweden
items.summary: SWECO: Sweco awarded framework agreements worth SEK 500 million for high-security facilities in Sweden 2026-10-19 08:00:00 Sweco has won three framework agreements with property company Specialfastigheter with an estimated combined order value of approximately SEK 500 million. The agreements cover feasibility studies, design, and project and construction management for properties used by the Swedish Prison and Probation Service, the Swedish Police Authority and the courts, all of which have stringent requirements for security and functionality.
